releases.notes:
# What's Changed
- Added staff mods: Xray is now unlocked on every server.
- Added full outfit support: you can now create, delete and switch between multiple outfits, and they are all saved.
- Fixed saved cosmetics sometimes going missing depending on how Lunar was launched. Saves now live in one fixed folder:
  - Windows: `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\prometheus\lunar`
  - macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/prometheus/lunar`
  - Linux: `$XDG_DATA_HOME/prometheus/lunar` (usually `~/.local/share/...`)

  Your existing outfit, emotes, sprays and badge are copied over automatically on first launch.
- Fixed badges with high IDs not being saved correctly, and unequipping a badge not being remembered.
- Updated for Lunar Client 2.23.0.

This is the first release where we used Claude (Anthropic's AI coding assistant) during development, in line with the AI policy in our [contributing guide](https://github.com/prometheusreengineering/minecraft-lunar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/prometheusreengineering/minecraft-lunar/compare/1.2.1...1.3.0
